# ISP Cloud & LLM Monitor

> Open-source Python CLI for ISP diagnostics, AWS/Azure reachability, and OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Kimi (Moonshot) and Mistral API health checks, generating offline HTML and CSV reports. No secrets are bundled.

The bundled report and screenshots are **simulated demo data**, not live ISP or cloud measurements. SSH checks banners, not authentication. LLM model-listing tests availability, not inference speed. Never paste API keys into source code, issues, or generated reports. Crawler identification and LLM API providers are different concepts.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): Features, setup, CLI commands, report interpretation, images, testing.
- [LLM usage guide](docs/LLM_USAGE.md): API key setup, model listing, live monitoring and inference examples.
- [LLM provider and model index](docs/LLM_INDEX.md): Built-in vendor endpoints and how to generate an account-specific model catalog.
- [AI bot/crawler index](docs/AI_BOT_INDEX.md): User-agent registry and explanations of robots policy.

## Machine-readable references

- [LLM and crawler registry](llm_index.json): Public JSON with presets and documented crawler tokens, no credentials.
- [Agent/contributor instructions](AGENTS.md): Safe automation and source-of-truth guidance.
- [Crawler sample policy](robots.txt): Only effective when deployed at an origin's website root.

## Optional

- [Full LLM-readable documentation](llms-full.txt): Expanded project context.
